evidence_quotes.quote: J. Korea Water Resour. Assoc. Vol. 57, No. 6 (2024), pp. 393-407
Using the Coulter model for 152 local governments across the country, equity was measured for six variables,
전국 161개 지방상수도 사업자 중 특·광역시와 특별자치도를 제외한 152개 지자체(시·군)를 대상으로 2010년, 2016년,
또한 토빗회귀분석을 통해 형평성 영향요인을 비형평성 계수에 미치는 영향을 기준으로 확인한 결과, 재정자립도는 모든 변수에서
정(+)의 영향을, 1인당 지방세 부담액은 부(-)의 영향을, 시/군 여부는 고객만족도를 제외한 5가지 계수에 부(-)의 영향을 끼치는 것으로 나타났다.

effect_estimate.comment: Two-stage quantitative results reported across 152 local governments for 2010, 2016, and 2021; both Tobit and robustness OLS regressions yielded virtually identical point estimates and significance levels.
effect_estimate.value: Across 152 local governments (2010, 2016, 2021), Coulter's coefficient of inequity (I; 0 = perfect equity, >10 = minor/slight inequity) was highest and worsened over time for average unit water price (I = 10.6 in 2010, 10.8 in 2016, 11.3 in 2021; 2021 mean 900.08 won/m3, range 404.80-1,750.08 won/m3) and water supply coverage rate (I = 9.5 in 2010, 10.2 in 2016, 10.4 in 2021; 2021 mean 98.15%, range 64.50%-100%), while cost recovery rate (8.7, 8.6, 9.1), revenue water ratio (9.5, 9.6, 9.9), employee count (6.1, 6.7, 6.8), and customer complaints (9.7, 8.8, 8.7) remained below 10. In Tobit regressions of local inequity coefficients (Obs = 152 per year), city vs. county administrative status (si = 1, gun = 0) significantly lowered inequity in 5 of 6 outcomes (2021 Coef. = -0.9174, SE 0.3006, p<0.01 for average unit price; -0.9064, SE 0.3714, p<0.05 for cost recovery; -0.8489, SE 0.3290, p<0.05 for revenue water ratio; -0.8566, SE 0.3149, p<0.01 for water supply rate; -1.1569, SE 0.3726, p<0.01 for staff; non-significant for customer complaints [-0.2666, SE 0.3579]), degree of fiscal independence (%) significantly increased inequity across all 6 outcomes in all years (2021 Coef. = 0.1353, SE 0.0141, p<0.01 for unit price; 0.1382, SE 0.0148, p<0.01 for water supply rate), and log per-capita local tax burden significantly reduced inequity across all 6 outcomes (2021 Coef. = -1.9115, SE 0.4815, p<0.01 for unit price; -1.9333, SE 0.5044, p<0.01 for water supply rate). Mayor re-election, private consignment, and local public enterprise status showed no statistically significant effects except private consignment increasing customer-complaint inequity in 2010 only (Coef. = 1.3224, SE 0.4552, p<0.01).
